request: How large is the immigration court backlog and how has it changed over time?

reply.reply:
**EOIR had 3,558,995 pending immigration court cases at the end of FY2024; the backlog surpassed 1 million in FY2019 and continued to grow.**

- EOIR had 3,558,995 cases pending at the end of FY2024. (IN12492, PDF p. 4)
- In FY2024, immigration judges completed 701,749 cases, while EOIR received an average of 148,663 new cases per month. (IN12492, PDF p. 4)
- The pending immigration-court caseload first exceeded 1 million in FY2019 and was reported at 1,405,386 million cases at the end of FY2021. (R47077, PDF p. 21)
reply.reasoning: CRS reports 3,558,995 pending cases at the end of FY2024 and says the backlog exceeded 1 million in FY2019, then continued increasing. FY2024 receipts substantially outpaced completed cases, consistent with further growth.
